description: The configured stream file has been rotated away; only the previous generation remains beside it, under a name nothing is configured to read. The handshake still succeeds, because the configuration is valid and nothing has been asked of the source yet. The search then fails with source_unavailable (-32000) rather than returning zero candidates, which is the invariant this case exists to hold: a source that cannot be reached must never be indistinguishable from one with no matches. Health reports unavailable with unknown coverage. The diagnostic names the file by base name only — diagnostics carry no local paths.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
